entries.content:
The bug is already fixed: B_336 is the same error as B_306, which shipped in 0.10.0.

**What happened**
- The Sentry error comes from the old check in the desktop `WorktreeService.integrate`. When files in the primary worktree weren't committed (here `F_445_diagrams_delete_key.md` and `usage_metrics.csv`), integration threw this error.
- B_306 (`design/releases/0.10.0/B_306_error_primary_worktree_has_uncommitted_changes_c.md`) replaced that throw. Integration now returns a `dirtyPrimary` outcome, and the "Uncommitted project changes" dialog opens so you can commit or trash the files and carry on.
- That change was made in commit `c922d3ecc` on 2026-10-24. The current code has it: `desktop/src/git/worktree_service.js:522` returns `dirtyPrimary`, and `app/src/services/project/worktree_service.ts:708` runs the review loop. The old error message no longer appears anywhere in the app or desktop source.
- The version wasn't raised to 0.10.0 until 2026-11-04 (commit `28d25c1d6`). Sentry last saw this error on 2026-10-29, so all 12 events came from 0.9.x builds made before the fix was released.

**Proposed solution**
- No code change is needed. Close B_336 as a duplicate of B_306. If the error shows up again from a 0.10.0 or later build, reopen it.
- Optional: Sentry shows the release as "Not provided", which is why this took digging to confirm. Tagging Sentry events with the app version would make it easy to tell old builds from current ones. Tell me if you want that as its own card.
